base.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production clan anniversary enamel badge PNG, transparent background.
Input image: the approved "Growing History" four-badge comparison sheet.
Extract ONLY the far-left bronze-bordered tree shield as ONE large isolated badge. Preserve exactly its shield silhouette, five enamel leaves (emerald center and lower leaves, mint upper side leaves), ivory field, champagne-gold trunk, mirrored roots, small four-point star and diamond near the roots, wide bronze outer rim, all internal seams, proportions and lighting. This is the selected approved design; do not redesign or invent decorations. The existing tree and roots must match the reference faithfully.
Composition: one badge, front-facing, upright, centered on a square canvas, full silhouette visible, badge occupies about 90 percent of canvas height with a small even transparent safety margin, enough width to preserve original proportions. No other badges, no title, no year, no numerals, no captions. No backdrop, no colored rectangle, no checkerboard, no drop shadow beyond the object silhouette. Genuine transparent alpha background. Sharp polished hard-enamel and sculpted metal texture at high resolution, consistent with the approved source.
